# skills-hr

A Claude Code skill suite for HR managers and recruiters. Four skills for the full hiring lifecycle — from writing the job description to closing the candidate.

## Skills

### /job-description-writer
Writes inclusive, compelling job descriptions that attract strong candidates and reduce bias.
- Separates must-haves from wish lists (reduces requirement inflation)
- Built-in bias check: gendered language, unnecessary degree requirements, age-coded terms
- Outputs: full ATS version (500-700 words) + LinkedIn version (250 words) + 3 outreach subject lines
- Triggers: job description, write JD, job posting, job listing, open role, job ad, hiring for

### /interview-kit
Generates a complete structured interview kit for any role.
- Behavioral questions mapped to competencies, with STAR format + follow-up probes
- Technical/skills scenarios with level-calibrated expectations
- Illegal questions reference card
- 1-4 scoring rubric with behavioral anchors
- Debrief facilitation guide with groupthink prevention
- Triggers: interview questions, interview kit, interview guide, candidate interview, structured interview, behavioral questions, interview prep

### /offer-letter-generator
Drafts professional, warm offer letters that make candidates excited to join.
- Covers all legally necessary elements (at-will, contingencies, I-9, equity disclosure)
- Two versions: formal PDF-ready letter + email version
- Legal checklist before sending
- Supports complex comp: RSUs, options, sign-on with clawback, bonus structures
- Triggers: offer letter, write offer, job offer, compensation offer, employment offer, offer package

### /performance-review-helper
Drafts balanced, specific, actionable performance reviews.
- Works for manager → direct report, self-evaluation, and 360 peer feedback
- Transforms vague impressions into impact statements with evidence
- Built-in bias check: flags personality vs. behavior language, double standards, attribution asymmetry
- Outputs: accomplishments, strengths narrative, growth areas, rating justification, SMART goals
- Triggers: performance review, write review, employee review, performance feedback, annual review, self review, 360 feedback

## Installation

```bash
npm install @gonzih/skills-hr
```

Skills are installed to `~/.claude/skills/`. Restart Claude Code to activate.
